title: Mixing: Be My Baby, Just Because by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

John Lennon mixed two songs in stereo for his Rock ‘N’ Roll album on 8 October 1974.

Lennon had recently re-recorded his lead vocals for two songs, ‘Just Because’ and ‘Be My Baby’, although the latter song was mixed again on 14 October and ultimately left off the album.
